metadata.title: metacih-project/data-psychiatric-disorders-mbi: 26.0.0
metadata.description: Database of mindfulness-based interventions for individuals with psychiatric disorders.

metadata/variable_description.json.condition_arm1: Type of treatment (mb-eat= Mindfulness-Based Eating Awareness Training (MB-EAT), mbct= Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT), mbrp= Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention, mbsr= Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR), mbsr/mb-eat= MBSR/MB-EAT, mbsr/mbct= MBSR/MBCT, mbsr/mbct/mb-eat= MBSR/MBCT/MB-EAT, more= Mindfulness-Oriented Recovery Enhancement, mts= Mindfulness Training for Smokers, none= None, pbct= Person-Based Cognitive Therapy)
metadata/variable_description.json.condition_arm2: Type of comparator (ebt= Evidence-based Treatment, minimal treatment= Minimal Treatment, no treatment= No Treatment, non-specific active control= Non-specific Active Control, specific active control= Specific Active Control)
metadata/variable_description.json.multi_arm1: In multiarm trials, this variable provides a specification of the type of treatment used in the first arm. This variable is set to NA (missing) when the study was not a multiarm trial. For example, if a multiarm trial employed two types of MBCBT interventions, face-to-face and Internet-based, this variable would be set to f2f and Internet, respectively.
metadata/variable_description.json.multi_arm2: In multiarm trials, this variable provides a specification of the type of treatment used in the second arm. This variable is set to NA (missing) when the study was not a multiarm trial. For example, if a multiarm trial employed two types of control groups, no treatment and MBCT, this variable would be set to no treatment and ebt, respectively.
metadata/variable_description.json.outcome_type: This variable encodes the type of outcome that builds the basis of the comparison, e.g. response, remission or deterioration. This is variable is particularly relevant for dichotomous effect size data, because it indicates what the event counts refer to. The msd factor level is typically used for outcomes expressed in means and standard deviations.
metadata/variable_description.json.instrument: Instrument through which the relevant outcome was measured
metadata/variable_description.json.time: Measurement point at which the outcome was obtained (e.g. post or follow-up)
metadata/variable_description.json.time_weeks: Measurement point at which the outcome was obtained, in weeks after randomization (set to NA if this information was not available)
metadata/variable_description.json.baseline_m_arm1: Mean of the outcome in the first arm at baseline
metadata/variable_description.json.baseline_m_arm2: Mean of the outcome in the second arm at baseline
metadata/variable_description.json.baseline_sd_arm1: Standard deviation of the outcome in the first arm at baseline
metadata/variable_description.json.baseline_sd_arm2: Standard deviation of the outcome in the second arm at baseline
metadata/variable_description.json.mean_arm1: Mean of the outcome in the first arm at the measured time point
metadata/variable_description.json.mean_arm2: Mean of the outcome in the second arm at the measured time point
metadata/variable_description.json.sd_arm2: Standard deviation of the outcome in the second arm at the measured time point
metadata/variable_description.json.sd_arm1: Standard deviation of the outcome in the first arm at the measured time point
metadata/variable_description.json.n_arm1: Sample size in the first trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.n_arm2: Sample size in the second trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.mean_change_arm1: Mean score change between baseline and the measured time point in the first arm
metadata/variable_description.json.mean_change_arm2: Mean score change between baseline and the measured time point in the second arm
metadata/variable_description.json.sd_change_arm1: Standard deviation of the mean change in the first arm
metadata/variable_description.json.sd_change_arm2: Standard deviation of the mean change in the second arm
metadata/variable_description.json.n_change_arm1: Sample size in the first trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.n_change_arm2: Sample size in the second trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.event_arm1: Number of events (responders, remission, deterioration cases) in the first trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.event_arm2: Number of events (responders, remission, deterioration cases) in the second trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.totaln_arm1: Total sample size in the first trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.totaln_arm2: Total sample size in the second trial arm
metadata/variable_description.json.precalc_g: The pre-calculated value of Hedges' g (small-sample bias corrected standardized mean difference)
metadata/variable_description.json.precalc_log_rr: The pre-calculated value of the log-risk ratio logeRR, comparing events in the first arm to events in the second arm
metadata/variable_description.json.precalc_log_rr_se: The standard error of the log-risk ratio logeRR, comparing events in the first arm to events in the second arm
metadata/variable_description.json..id: Unique identifier for a trial arm comparison/row
metadata/variable_description.json.disorder: Clinical condition of participants (collapsed disorder category)
metadata/variable_description.json.disorder_details: More detailed information on clinical condition of participants (subcategory)
metadata/variable_description.json.country: Country in which the trial was conducted
metadata/variable_description.json.comorbid_mental: All the participants are recruited based on meeting criteria for a comorbid mental health disorder (e.g. anxiety and depression) (1= yes, 0= no)
metadata/variable_description.json.percent_ethnicity: Percentage of participants with non-Caucasian race
metadata/variable_description.json.percent_collegeeducation: Percentage of participants with some college education
metadata/variable_description.json.is.subsample: Whether effect is based on a subsample of a study (1= yes, 0= no)
metadata/variable_description.json.is.subscale: Whether scale is a subscale of an instrument (1= yes, 0= no)
metadata/variable_description.json.treatfreq_arm1: Treatment frequency in the intervention group
metadata/variable_description.json.boosternum_arm1: Number of booster sessions in the intervention group
metadata/variable_description.json.boosterlength_arm1: Length of booster sessions in the intervention group
metadata/variable_description.json.primary_study: Whether study is a primary study (1= yes, 0= no)
metadata/variable_description.json.single_study: Whether study is a single study (1= yes, 0= no)
